a(n) = Sum_{k = 0..n} C(n,k) * C(n+k,k) * C(n+2*k,k).

Start with a single equilateral triangle for n=0; for the odd n-th generation add a triangle at each expandable side of the triangles of the (n-1)-th generation (this is the "side to side" version); for the even n-th generation use the "vertex to side" version; a(n) is the number of triangles added
